entries.c56c0cf48e855bc2: A robot that automatically performs tasks such as painting, welding, assembly and transport in factories and similar sites. The "vertical articulated robot," which moves in many directions like a human arm, is the most common, and is used at many manufacturing sites, starting with automobile factories.
